support_spans: subepidermal blister lined by fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate, with scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining
Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva. Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum.
Purpuric macules present periorbitally, on the lips, inframammary folds, forearms, and thighs.
contradict_spans: Herpes simplex virus PCR from perineal ulcer swab was negative
